# RelayFlow

> Lightweight, code-first request-relaying and edge authentication library for ASP.NET Core wrapping YARP IHttpForwarder.

## Machine Discovery & Index
- [Agent Index](AGENTS.md): Machine-readable capabilities, non-goals, AST entry points, and verification commands.
- [README](README.md): Full human documentation, architecture diagrams, and fluent API guides.

## Core Capabilities
- Request forwarding with byte streaming via YARP IHttpForwarder
- SSRF deny-by-default allow-listing
- Edge credential swapping (ServiceToken, ApiKey, Claims projection)
- Per-destination circuit breaker (fast 503 on consecutive upstream failures)
- OpenTelemetry metrics and activity tracing

## Explicit Non-Goals
- NOT a standalone gateway product (not Ocelot/Envoy/Kong)
- NO automatic retries on forwarded requests
- NO database-driven dynamic route configuration
